Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.32 changes Lydia's paid closure date to the native Lou-style morning visit: the date is queued at the front while the game generates the morning customers, with no shutter-button patch or extra automatic-call workaround; presentation follows the normal opening flow. Stale closure state is cleared on load and re-queued the next morning. The 1.31 Korean proofreading merge, 1.30 harem v2 perfume coverage, 1.29 closure-date/reward/barter fixes, 1.28 Security channel and maid localization, 1.27 Serpico delay and earlier fixes remain. Story routes, outcomes, target days and endings are unchanged. 1.32 将莉迪亚付费闭店约会改为原版卢式晨间特殊来访：在游戏生成早晨顾客时直接插到队首，不再使用卷帘按钮补丁或额外自动叫号，展示交给正常开门流程；过期闭店状态会在读档时清理并在次晨重新排队。保留 1.31 韩语校对、1.30 后宫 v2 香水覆盖、1.29 闭店约会/奖励/警告礼修复、1.28 治安部渠道与侍从线本地化、1.27 Serpico 顺延及更早修复。不改路线、选项结果、目标日或结局。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
